title: Australian energy retailers must provide three hours of free daytime electricity
summary: Australian energy retailers will soon be required to offer three hours of free daytime electricity as part of new government regulations, likely leveraging excess solar energy during peak production hours to benefit consumers and reduce grid strain during high-demand periods.
problem_solved: Reducing electricity costs for Australian households during daytime hours when solar generation typically exceeds demand.
why_valuable: This policy helps consumers save money on energy bills while promoting renewable energy usage and reducing grid stress during peak solar production periods.
